0x007566.en: 「I'll show you what a Gespenst can do!」

0x007695.en: 「Take on the Grungust and/　you won't walk away free!」

0x007873.en: 「You think you can stop me and the SRX?!」

0x0078F0.en: 「Is your own greed all that/　matters to you people...?!」

0x00793D.en: 「Latooni and the rest aren't like you!」

0x00797D.en: 「So that's how you people/　come to terms with your past...!」

0x0079D9.en: 「If it's a test of power,/　that's my specialty too!」

0x007A45.en: 「Duvan,/　what can you do all on your own...?!」

0x007A9B.en: 「Duvan... I'll put you to rest right here!」

0x007AD8.en: 「That guy, I've seen him somewhere before...?!/　No, not now!」

0x007B22.en: 「Not psychic power, but this feeling.../ No, never mind that!」

0x007B8E.en: 「Like hell I'll lose to a computer!」

0x007BD1.en: 「General Kirkus!/　Aren't you using your power all wrong?!」

0x007C58.en: 「With Melior Esse right in front of me,/　there's no backing down!」

0x007CF1.en: 「I'll overcome it -/　this fear you people bring!」

0x007DAC.en: 「That one's different/　from the other Melior Esse...?!」

0x007E24.en: 「Perfectio! I won't let your twisted logic/　destroy the world!」

0x007E95.en: 「This world isn't so fragile/　you can crush it that easily!」

0x007FD1.en: 「Setting your sights on us/　was your first mistake!」

0x00802A.en: 「Kanan! I've no plan to become a sage!」

0x00808F.en: 「Monster-class size and psychic power? But still!」

0x0080D2.en: 「Son Ganglong... I'll pierce that psychic power!」

0x00810C.en: 「Guang Long,/　it may be a tired line but.../　you never know till you try!」

0x0081B8.en: 「I've got no intention/　of backing down either!」

0x008208.en: 「Gaia Sabers!/　I won't let you do as you please!」

0x00825B.en: 「If we're that much of an eyesore to you...!」

0x0082FD.en: 「I'll get to the bottom of this unease!」

0x008340.en: 「Galilnagant.../　I can't afford to lose to that!」

0x0083B2.en: 「Against a Double G, I can't let my guard down!」

0x008411.en: 「I've got a Super Robot too,/　I won't lose!」

0x00851C.en: 「Like hell I'll be hunted by you!」

0x008553.en: 「He's dangerous... I know it for sure!」

0x00858D.en: 「It's not psychic power.../　but I've felt this before...!」

0x0085DA.en: 「Don't think you can hunt the R Series too!」

0x008611.en: 「A hybrid machine of the surface/　and La Gias...!」

0x008680.en: 「Even against a Masou Kishin, I won't lose!」

0x008726.en: 「Now that's the face of/　an evil god, huh...!」

0x0087C0.en: 「I've got to deal with the Ruina fast!」

0x008813.en: 「A Cerberus and Garmraid/　fused into one, huh!」

0x008863.en: 「Don't think you can chew me up!」

0x008891.en: 「Erde, I'll show you.../　where AI1 ends up!」

0x008921.en: 「Guests, I won't let you do as you please!」

0x008961.en: 「I'll scatter the Guests to the winds!」

0x0089E2.en: 「So the Four Gods' Chokijin are our enemies now...!」

0x008A5A.en: 「KoOhKi, I'll snap you out of it!」

0x008A94.en: 「I'm not one to be scared by looks!」

0x008AC8.en: 「So it's 4,000 years of Chinese mystery, huh!」

0x008B4C.en: 「Even if it's a Custos,/　I can't back down here!」

0x008B9F.en: 「Protecting and binding/　aren't the same, Gan Eden!」

0x008BF5.en: 「Gan Eden!/　I'll defeat you and break the barrier!」

0x008C42.en: 「So you're the root of it, Euzeth!」

0x008C7C.en: 「I'll erase you, past-life memories and all!」

0x008CBF.en: 「You were controlling Instructor Ingram.../　That alone is reason enough to take you down!」

0x008D48.en: 「I'll return the pain you dealt me twofold!!」

0x008E03.en: 「You picked this fight, I'll finish it!」

0x008E72.en: 「I've got no intention of backing down!」

0x008EB5.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...?!」

0x008F2F.en: 「Guh!/　L-like hell I'll end... in a place like this!!」

0x008FBD.en: 「Ugh! I can still go! I can still fight!!」

0x009000.en: 「A pinch like this.../　I'll pull through it!!」

0x009059.en: 「What?!/　But you know.../　turning it around from here is what a/　Super Robot's all about!!」

0x009225.en: 「Heh, heheh... here it comes... /  the big pinch, right on cue...!」

0x009308.en: 「Th-then let's show 'em /  what we're made of, R-1!」

0x009364.en: 「Waah! /  For a Gespenst to be pushed this far!」

0x0093C0.en: 「Come on, Gespenst! /  You've still got fight in you!?」

0x00940D.en: 「Don't think the Grungust /  only has this much fight in it!」

0x00945A.en: 「D-damn it! /  Not even the Grungust can take it!?」

0x0094AD.en: 「For the Huckebein /  to take this much damage...!」

0x00950C.en: 「N-no good... /  The Huckebein's armor won't hold...!」

0x0096F6.en: 「I-if that psychic power swallows me up...!!」

0x009730.en: 「I'm not gonna get /  wiped out here of all places!」

0x009780.en: 「Gah! I won't let him hunt me down!」

0x009801.en: 「Damn, I underestimated a Masou Kishin's power!」

0x009869.en: 「What the hell is that /  turtle robot firing at me!」

0x0098BF.en: 「So the Chokijin of the /  Four Fiends is the real deal!」

0x009909.en: 「I-I won't let him eat me alive!」

0x009977.en: 「Like hell I'll become one with that!」

0x0099E2.en: 「Any grudge with you... /  I'll gladly pass on it!」

0x009A6F.en: 「Ngh, a fine attack... /  I'll take some notes on it!」

0x009AC5.en: 「Gah! /  I've got your face memorized now!」

0x009B0F.en: 「Whoa, they got me!! /  ...eh, no need to panic, really.」

0x009B68.en: 「This guy... /  dead set on stopping me...! But hey!」

0x009BC1.en: 「Nice! I like that attack of yours!」

0x009C01.en: 「Cr-crap... /  Captain Viletta's gonna chew me out!」

0x009CA0.en: 「Ngh! The Plus Parts took a hit!」

0x009CDA.en: 「I know! I just let my guard down!」

0x009DB0.en: 「Do I look like I'm slacking!? /  Eh, I do?」

0x009E00.en: 「Ugh! /  Aya, field support to the legs!」

0x009EA6.en: 「Don't think the R-1 falls that easy!」

0x009EE3.en: 「Damage check! /  Good, R-1... still going strong!」

0x009FD6.en: 「That's the Grungust! /  A direct hit and it's still fine!」

0x00A029.en: 「Not bad... /  going toe to toe with the Grungust!」

0x00A07F.en: 「Not yet! The Huckebein can still fight!」

0x00A102.en: 「Tch, took the bait /  on the Alblade, huh!」

0x00A1A2.en: 「Why does Amara /  keep reading my moves!?」

0x00A1EC.en: 「What, that weak little attack is all you've got?」

0x00A269.en: 「Tch, not half bad! /  I'll call it a handicap!」

0x00A2BC.en: 「A mistake of youth, huh... /  no time to strike a pose!」

0x00A361.en: 「Where'd I get hit!? /  ...huh, just a scratch on the armor.」

0x00A3BA.en: 「Damn, /  got distracted by their mech and took the hit.」

0x00A44A.en: 「At this rate /  Captain Viletta'll drill me again!」

0x00A4DA.en: 「Shut up! /  I'm watching where I'm going!!」

0x00A54F.en: 「My bad! /  Let's pretend that never happened!」

0x00A593.en: 「The SRX's damage is minor. No problem.」

0x00A5C7.en: 「You think an invincible super robot /  goes down that easy!?」

0x00A62C.en: 「Ryu, /  feel free to rely on the field!」

0x00A67C.en: 「Thanks, I'll take you up on it.」

0x00A6FA.en: 「Taking on the R-1... /  you're ten years too early!」

0x00A747.en: 「Damn... /  my R-1 got scratched up again!」

0x00A797.en: 「Don't think this is enough /  to stop the ART-1!」

0x00A7E4.en: 「Ngh! If something happens to it, /  Rob and the others'll rip into me.」

0x00A884.en: 「Don't make me laugh! /  You think that's enough for this Gespenst!?」

0x00A914.en: 「You need more power /  to punch through the Grungust's armor!」

0x00A96D.en: 「Ngh! /  Landing a hit on the Huckebein, /  not bad at all!」

0x00A9C7.en: 「Took the bait /  on the Huckebein, did you!?」

0x00AA4E.en: 「You've got some nerve /  scratching my Alblade!」

0x00AAB7.en: 「Can't drop my guard on a commander unit!」

0x00AAF4.en: 「Tch, that tone of his fooled me!」

0x00AC2D.en: 「Ngh! /  That attack speed - that's Double G for you!」

0x00ACB1.en: 「Good moves for such a big frame!」

0x00AD0D.en: 「Ngh, Euzeth... /  it won't go the way you want!」

0x00AE80.en: 「Fighting the Gespenst too /  is ten years too early!」

0x00AECA.en: 「Fighting the Grungust too is ten years too early!」

0x00AF0D.en: 「Fighting the Huckebein too /  is a hundred years too early!」

0x00AF97.en: 「The ART-1 had the speed edge there!」

0x00AFD7.en: 「I've got no time to play with you!」

0x00B0B7.en: 「So this is all a Melior Esse can do!」

0x00B1A9.en: 「Strong psychic's useless if it can't hit!」

0x00B267.en: 「Don't think you can hunt me down!」

0x00B28F.en: 「Duraxil... so long as it doesn't hit me!」

0x00B347.en: 「Getting hugged by a monster/ ain't my idea of fun!」

0x00B65D.en: 「Too much waste in your dodge pattern.」

0x00B68B.en: 「Let's just call that all's well that ends well!」

0x00B6C8.en: 「That pattern's no good. Next time, you'll get hit.」

0x00B7C3.en: 「Ngh......!/ That dodge pattern was, what, 60 points!?」

0x00B83E.en: 「I see... Huh? Was that praise just now?」

0x00B90E.en: 「Gaia Sabers,/ I won't lose to you!」

0x00B98C.en: 「So that's all an evil god can do!」

0x00BA1F.en: 「Some Four Fiends Chokijin - not much to it!」

0x00BA62.en: 「I got used to fighting monsters last war!」

0x00BACD.en: 「No use! You're a thousand years too early!!」

0x00BBB0.en: 「Coward! I can't reach you way over there!」

0x00BCB2.en: 「Time to blast you one more time!」

0x00BCEF.en: 「All right! I'll lend a hand too!!」

0x00BE99.en: 「Just like Captain...! I won't lose either!」

0x00BF66.en: 「Good! Leave the rest to me, Latooni!」

0x00C2D7.en: 「Ens. Hugo, leave the rest to me!」

0x00C4AA.en: 「Hold on a sec!/ Heh, I'll take this one!」

0x00C4FA.en: 「At least let me do this much!」

0x00CC04.en: 「Will it to shatter... become a blade!!」

0x00CC32.en: 「You two, we're going with Formation R!」

0x00D23F.en: 「T-LINK full contact!/ Metal Genocider Mode, activate!」

0x00DA57.en: 「Mai, let's go with Psychic Combo Fist!」

0x00DBCF.en: 「If it's come to this, I'll use this!」

0x00E456.en: 「I'll blow a hole in your gut!」

0x00F055.en: 「Old Iron secret art!/　Final Joker Card!」

0x00F75E.en: 「I'll show you a Cho-Toshi's killing blade!」
